jurisdiction.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has no AI-specific law and no published AI strategy. AI appears in the 2019 Plan National du Numérique Horizon 2025, which includes an action to launch AI projects, and in the 2023 Code du numérique, which gives the National Digital Council a remit over AI ethics and sets rules on automated decisions and impact assessments; the Code's official text could not be read because the official gazette was unreachable. A first national AI strategy was validated by the government in August 2026 but has not been published.
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but the official gazette, the legal database and the telecom regulator's websites could not be accessed, so only the 2019 digital plan could be read. The 2023 Digital Code and the national AI strategy are listed as leads. The DR Congo is marked for a later retry and, as a large country with few records, for a longer catch-up pass.

instruments.english_title: National Digital Plan "Horizon 2025" (For a connected and high-performing DRC)
instruments.issuing_authority: Presidency of the Republic (Office of the Head of State; Special Adviser to the Head of State in charge of Digital), drafted by the Cadre de Concertation of digital-sector experts
instruments.current_status: Validated at the national validation workshop on 5 September 2019 (opened by the President on 3 September 2019) and published by the Presidency (document dated September 2019). Its 2025 horizon has passed; a successor Plan National du Numérique 2026-2030 (PNN2) and a first national AI strategy (SNIA) were being prepared by the Ministry of Digital Economy in 2025-2026 but no official text was found online as of 12 October 2026 (see leads), so this plan is not recorded as superseded.
instruments.summary: The DRC's national digital plan to 2025, built on four strategic pillars (infrastructure; content; applications/uses; governance and regulation) broken down into strategic axes, objectives, actions and a chronogram of priority actions. It is a digital strategy rather than an AI strategy, but its infrastructure pillar includes an action to initiate projects in artificial intelligence, augmented reality, robotics and related fields and to create research centres, and it sets out an institutional framework for implementing the plan.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: The country's only published national digital strategy with explicit AI actions; precursor to the national AI strategy under preparation.

leads.title: Ordonnance-loi n° 23/010 du 13 mars 2023 portant Code du numérique
leads.english_title: Ordinance-Law No. 23/010 of 13 March 2023 on the Digital Code
leads.issuing_authority: President of the Republic (ordinance-law; ratified by Parliament)
leads.note: Main AI-relevant binding law: art. 12 tasks the Conseil National du Numérique with overseeing the ethics of advanced digital tech, including AI; Book II Title III (personal data) creates an Autorité de protection des données, gives a right to information on automated decision-making including profiling, and art. 245 requires a data protection impact assessment for systematic automated evaluation/profiling producing legal effects. Text (168 pp., 'Fait à Kinshasa, le 13 mars 2023', in force on promulgation) was read only from a non-official copy (discovery). No official full text could be reached: the Journal officiel (journalofficiel.cd) returned HTTP 503 to curl and WebFetch, ARPTC (arptc.gouv.cd) and leganet.cd failed (TLS/503), and the Secrétariat Général au Numérique site (numerique.gouv.cd) is a placeholder. Record as binding_law / binding-law, data-privacy, government-governance, ethics once the official JO text is reachable.

leads.title: Stratégie Nationale de l'Intelligence Artificielle (SNIA) de la République Démocratique du Congo
leads.english_title: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of the DRC
leads.note: Drafting launched 8 October 2025 with PNN2; technical validation workshop 23-24 July 2026; presented and validated by members of the Government on 4 August 2026 and to be submitted to the Council of Ministers for formal adoption (press reports only). No official text or Council of Ministers record found online on 12 October 2026 (primature.gouv.cd and presidence.cd searched). Record as national_strategy once published; it may supersede the PNN Horizon 2025 for AI.
